description: Call this to weigh the options in one area instead of taking find_best's single recommendation, or when the user asks "which is the cheapest / most reliable X API?". Returns every tracked API in the category ranked by score, with price per call, reliability, usage and any warnings. Category ids: web-search, web-extraction, llm-inference, crypto-prices, onchain-data, enrichment, weather, news, social-media, jobs, ecommerce, maps-places, translation, messaging, travel, stocks, pdf-generation, captcha-solving, sports-data. Narrow by platform or task ids from list_categories. Free, read-only and quick: it never calls or pays the APIs it describes.

platform.description: Sub-category platform ids, any of, e.g. ["instagram","tiktok"]. See list_categories

rail.description: Paid rails to include, e.g. ["x402"] for pay-per-call only (default both)

recent.description: true = only endpoints checked in the last 7 days

task.description: Sub-category task ids, any of, e.g. ["comments"]. See list_categories

name: compare_category
title: Compare APIs in a category
